### Functional Food Integration
**ID:** C91 **Created:** 2025-06-05

Functional food integration involves strategically incorporating foods that provide health benefits beyond basic nutrition, including bioactive compounds, probiotics, prebiotics, and naturally occurring performance-enhancing substances. This approach maximizes the therapeutic potential of whole foods while supporting athletic performance and health outcomes through food-first nutrition strategies.

**Core Components:**
- **Bioactive Compound Optimization:** Integrating foods rich in natural [[C34. Antioxidants]], polyphenols, and phytonutrients that support recovery and performance enhancement
- **Probiotic and Prebiotic Integration:** Strategically using fermented foods and fiber-rich options to optimize [[C32. Gut Health and Microbiome]] for improved nutrient absorption and immune function
- **Natural Performance Enhancement:** Incorporating foods with proven ergogenic properties as alternatives to synthetic [[C24. Ergogenic Aids]] while maintaining competitive advantage
- **Anti-Inflammatory Food Systems:** Building meal plans around [[C33. Anti-Inflammatory FoodsDiets]] that naturally reduce exercise-induced inflammation and support recovery
- **Nutrient Synergy Optimization:** Combining foods to enhance [[C58. Nutrient Bioavailability Optimization]] and maximize the absorption and utilization of key nutrients
